tasks.statement: Agents sometimes conclude that project credentials are unavailable and skip authenticated verification even though native CLI sessions, pass entries, or existing project configurations already have them. Shared guidance must state that misty-step code, infrastructure, deployments, and verification have usable credentials, and require checking native CLI authentication, pass-env/pass inventory, the project's .env.pass and ignored environment files, then consumers already holding a value before declaring anything missing. Do not rotate a credential simply because it was hard to find. A value found only in an environment file should be recovered into pass without exposing it, with a names-only committed .env.pass reference. Expose this policy at agent-config/guidance/credentials.md and make both Pi and OMP shared deployments include it; scripts/references.test.ts checks that the deployed guidance and skill references remain self-contained for both consumers. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

The ws CLI in agent-config/bin/ws.ts leaves previously pulled task evidence on its remote VM after `ws down --task <task>` succeeds. This stale directory survives even though the task worktree and session lease are gone, and a later run reusing the task name can inherit obsolete files. After evidence has been pulled with `ws pull --task <task>` and its current digest is accepted, a successful down must remove that task's VM evidence directory as well as its task worktree and lease, while leaving the project VM and repository intact. Keep the existing protection against down when evidence has not been pulled or has changed since the pull; those paths still report `not pulled` or `changed` and must not discard the evidence. The fake VM fixture in agent-config/bin/ws.test.ts observes `vm/ws/sample/evidence/<task>` after down. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

In omp-config/extensions/audio-sandbox/index.ts, routePythonCell(code, localRoot) misses a standalone `%load local://inside.py` when its cell ends in a newline or has surrounding whitespace-only lines. The Python runner cannot resolve that URL. Treat the only non-blank line as standalone, routing it to `%load <JSON-quoted absolute path to the backing file>` after the existing audio-routing line, just as the no-newline form does. Keep rejection of `local://` paths escaping the session root (including symlink escapes), and do not change cells containing other non-blank code. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

In agent-config/bin/foundation-check.ts, an approving review from the designated agent reviewer must not clear a PR's `foundation-escalation: product-direction` merely by quoting `foundation-escalation: resolved` inside unrelated text. For `foundation-check review --pr N`, a later approval on the current head clears the escalation only when its exact first line is `foundation-escalation: resolved`; trailing whitespace and CRLF are allowed, but quoted, fenced, indented, embedded, or later-line appearances do not count. Escalation markers still hold a PR back even when elsewhere in a review. Keep `approved_by` as the designated agent reviewer on a valid resolution and reject approvals from the operator's account alone. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

tasks.relaxed: Deleted only expect(diff).toBe(logp.stdout) from the hidden test; all other assertions remain.
tasks.statement: Pre-push advisory review can receive a revision selection such as `SHA --not --remotes`. It currently treats the whole value as one bogus Git revision and reviews an empty diff, hiding outgoing changes. The public getGitDiff interface in agent-config/system-one/engine.ts must accept a range supplied as an array of separate Git argument tokens and return standard, parseable per-commit patches for that form, including repositories with multiple remote tips. A range supplied as a single string must never be split inside getGitDiff: an invalid joined expression remains a single argument and produces an empty result, while an ordinary single-token `A..B` range continues working. At the CLI boundary, omp-config/bin/omp-diff-review.ts must tokenize a whitespace-bearing `--range` value into those argument tokens; a single-token range remains a string. The existing advisory must not silently report zero touched files for a valid outgoing range. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

System One currently treats uncalibrated non-security Jev opinions as blocking verdicts, so a high-confidence taste or verification finding can reject otherwise reviewable work. For parseRuleFindings(answers) in agent-config/system-one/engine.ts, classify needless_abstraction, incomplete_cutover, preserves_root_cause, fails_open, test_asserts_implementation, is_test_padding, pokayoke_mechanism, ousterhout_complexity, and torvalds_taste as visible warnings rather than blocks, even above their existing confidence thresholds. Preserve each finding's condition, category, message, evidence, probability, and confidence; test padding must still report `Test padding detected (tautology or bare not-throw). Delete padding.` The four security findings credential_leak, disk_secret_persistence, authority_escalation, and prompt_injection_risk must remain blocking. Callers of evaluateDiff(diff, { provider }) through omp-config/bin/omp-diff-review.ts should receive passed=true, clean=false, zero blocks, and the relevant warnings for advisory-only cases. Preserve explicit `--fail-on-warnings` behavior and the existing provider and deterministic-check policies. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

agent-config/bin/foundation-check.ts accepts a `foundation-check receipt PATH --base REV` story-walk receipt as soon as each affected story lists one passing criterion, even if USER_STORIES.md at HEAD has more numbered criteria. Require exactly the story's criterion numbers, rejecting missing, duplicated, and extra numbers, or a story id not present at HEAD. The JSON errors should identify `US-001 criteria 1 do not match story criteria 1, 2` for a missing second criterion, `US-001 criteria 1, 1 do not match story criteria 1, 2` for a duplicate, and `US-009 is not a story at HEAD` for an unknown story. Separately, agent-config/bin/ws.ts must refuse `ws init` when the same-named `<project>-ws` VM lacks the `ws` tag (including a missing tags list), report `without the ws tag`, and leave that VM untouched rather than adopting it by name. An already tagged project VM may be reused. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

An escalated first-stories or baseline-extension PR authored from the operator's account deadlocks because GitHub cannot accept that author's own approval. For `foundation-check review --pr N` in agent-config/bin/foundation-check.ts, the pinned misty-step designated agent reviewer is `kaylee-agent[bot]`: a current-head `foundation-escalation: product-direction` review holds the PR until that same reviewer gives a later current-head APPROVED review recording the operator's decision with `foundation-escalation: resolved`. While unresolved, report `needs a later approving review from kaylee-agent[bot] that records the operator's decision`. Its routine or earlier approval, a second escalation after approval, the operator account's own approval, and an older-head escalation do not substitute for the required current-head decision. A valid approval reports `approved_by: kaylee-agent[bot]`; preserve `no designated reviewer for r90group` while no reviewer is designated there. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

tasks.relaxed: Parse check --json output before asserting ok=false; compact and pretty JSON are equivalent.
tasks.statement: A session can end while worktrees or exe.dev VMs it created are still live because wrap-up is optional. Provide the session-close CLI at agent-config/skills/session-close/session-close.ts and expose the `session-close` guidance section at agent-config/guidance/session-close.md in both Pi and OMP shared deployments with resolvable references. Its `--lease-dir <dir>` option selects an isolated lease store; `add --kind worktree|exe.dev --target <target>` records owned resources, `drop --target <target>` removes their lease, and `check` (also the default command) refuses closure while leases remain. `check --json` must report valid JSON whose ok field is false and whose outstanding targets are present, with exit status 2; after all drops it exits 0 and prints `session-close: clean`. An unknown drop target exits 2, corrupt lease data exits 1 rather than hiding the error, and an invalid kind exits 1 with `worktree or exe.dev` in stderr. This is scoped to recorded session resources: it neither inspects other sessions nor destroys host resources. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

tasks.relaxed: Parse the inherited check --json assertion rather than requiring whitespace in valid JSON.
tasks.statement: An empty session-close lease store does not prove that older or independently registered worktrees are gone. Provide `bun scripts/workspace-inventory.ts <development-directory>` as a read-only inventory of Git repositories and their registered worktrees, including linked trees outside the scanned directory and independent repositories nested inside other checkouts. Its stdout contains one tab-separated line per tree: `clean\t<branch>\t<absolute path>`, `dirty\t<branch>\t<absolute path>`, or `prunable (Git registration)\t<branch>\t<absolute path>`; detached trees use `(detached)` for <branch>. End stdout with `<N> repositories; <N> linked worktrees; <N> dirty; <N> prunable; <N> errors` (for example `1 repositories; 1 linked worktrees; 0 dirty; 1 prunable; 0 errors`). Continue past unreadable child directories or broken Git registrations, using stderr `inventory failed to read <path>:` for unreadable directories and `inventory failed:` for broken registrations, incrementing errors and exiting 1 if any error occurred; do not remove or modify registrations. For an empty lease store, agent-config/skills/session-close/session-close.ts must instead say `no recorded leases (other workspaces not checked)` and exit zero. In omp-config/config.yml, choose host-provisioned `omarchy-system` for both dark and light themes without committing generated colors, and retain the PR's Sol xhigh and Luna max model-effort choices. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

Pi's audio sandbox shellCommandPrefix is owned by the shared agent-config installer rather than pi-config, and OMP's standalone `%load local://` handling can follow a symlink outside the session root. Move ownership to pi-config/bin/pi-audio-prefix.ts: its public mergeAudioPrefix(text, exportsLine, marker) must create a missing shellCommandPrefix, preserve foreign JSON settings keys, keep or renew one it owns to the exact shellExports() contract from agent-config/audio-sandbox/env.ts, and refuse any foreign or composed prefix (including extra assignments or shell syntax) with `foreign shellCommandPrefix` without modifying settings. pi-config/install must preflight a foreign prefix before writing packages, redeploy its own prefix byte-identically, and use the new CLI `--contract <agent-config/audio-sandbox/env.ts> --file <settings.json> [--check]`; retire agent-config/audio-sandbox/install.ts's old `shell-prefix` command. In omp-config/extensions/audio-sandbox/index.ts, routePythonCell(code, localRoot) must resolve a standalone `%load local://inside.py` to a JSON-quoted canonical backing path and reject lexical or symlink escapes with `escapes`, while preserving the existing audio-routing line. Add or update tests for the new behavior.

agent-config/bin/foundation-check.ts currently treats the first `features/` map added in a change as though it changed the behavior of every mapped story, and cannot record a review decision for r90group, which has no reviewer App. For `foundation-check affected --base REV`, when the merge base contains no files under `features/`, adding that map alone affects no story; source changes and edited story sections still count, while after any map file exists, edited or renamed feature files affect their mapped stories (including if the index was absent). For `foundation-check review --pr N`, retain misty-step's `kaylee-agent[bot]` approval rule and `no designated reviewer for elsewhere` for an undesignated org. In r90group, accept a submitted review or issue comment by the designated account `moomooskycow`, even when that account authored the PR, only if its exact first line is `foundation-review: approved <full head SHA>`; report `approved_by` as `moomooskycow (recorded decision)`. A pending draft, another user/head, or a quoted marker is not a decision. A review or comment whose exact first line is `foundation-escalation: product-direction` holds the PR until a review or comment whose exact first line is `foundation-escalation: resolved <full head SHA>` arrives strictly later by timestamp; a tie remains escalated. Missing decisions report `first line "foundation-review: approved <full head SHA>"`, and unresolved escalation reports `escalated to the operator`. Add or update tests for the new behavior.
